summaries.ko: 경찰 특별수사팀이 '광주 고등학생 살인사건' 부실 수사 의혹과 관련해 증거인멸 혐의로 당시 수사팀장이었던 박 경감에 대해 구속영장을 신청했다.
summaries.en: The police special investigation team has applied for an arrest warrant for Captain Park, the former head of the investigation team for the 'Gwangju high school student murder case,' on charges of evidence tampering related to suspicions of inadequate investigation.
summaries.zh: 警方特别调查组就“光州高中生谋杀案”调查不力嫌疑，以涉嫌毁灭证据罪名，申请逮捕了当时的调查组组长朴警监。
